figurative_meaning_en: Singular or one in number (one is sufficient)
example_sentences_in_bangla: একটা ফল দাও, বাকিগুলো লাগবে না।
example_sentences_in_english: Give me one fruit, the rest are not needed.
He bought one book, that's enough.
note: This appears to be a basic expression rather than a complex idiom; used to indicate minimal quantity.
